/projects/next-poi-gnn/.alt: Next-POI recommendation. The model as a diagram. Seven inputs, the last visited place, the user, and the place at five coarser levels labeled G@2 to G@6, enter an embedding layer, then a block labeled GRN with an attention box inside that also takes two small graphs, then a feed-forward layer that outputs the next place at each level.
